qwen2.5:7b-instruct.span: This can only be known by systematically investigating the interval estimates.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.span: Therefore, editors and policymakers should continue to emphasize the inclusion of interval estimates in research.

note: Agreement measures consistency between models, not correctness. Two models can agree on a wrong answer, and models with overlapping training data correlate in their errors, so this reads higher than true independence would warrant. Precision and recall against the human-rated reference set are reported separately and are what establish whether a flagged statement is really a gap.
